_meta.title: dgx-monarch WanDancer global-to-local bridge, uly2 (ComfyUI API format)
_meta.usage: POST this whole document to /prompt on a ComfyUI whose custom_nodes has dgx-monarch. Shape-only fixture: checkpoint/VAE/CLIP/audio filenames are placeholders that do not need to resolve to real files (see docs/MODELS.md, issue #137). Node '12' (WanDancerPadKeyframesList) is a stock list-output node. ComfyUI auto-iterates nodes '13' through '16' once per emitted segment; num_segments below (2) is a placeholder the operator must recompute from their staged audio's duration before an acceptance run. This fixture ends at per-segment SaveImage (frames only); combining the per-segment frame batches into one video file is a stock ComfyUI concern (e.g. a video-combine node) and is intentionally left out so the graph stays built only from nodes already covered by this repo's node contract. Wire a combine step downstream of node '16' yourself if you need one file. Two-checkpoint contract (hardware-corrected 2026-07-28): the release ships SEPARATE global and local checkpoints; the global stage samples node '2' (*_global_*) and the local stage samples its own loader node '18' (*_local_*). One shared checkpoint for both stages was the original placeholder shape and is wrong. Filenames follow the public release layout. IMAGE CONDITIONING IS REQUIRED (hardware-measured 2026-07-28): running WanDancer without start_image + clip_vision_output produces non-finite latents on EVERY topology. Stock ComfyUI silently saves the NaN result as all-black frames, while dgx-monarch's output validator refuses it loudly. Node '21' is the reference dancer image: start_image for the global stage, CLIP-vision for both stages (the local stage's start_image/mask come from the bridge node '12').

inputs.text: a dancer performing to the beat, medium shot, studio lighting
